name: Cuican Shike ~Yǔ Nǚ Tongshi Aimeibuqīng De Qīnmi Guānxi~
original_name: 璀璨時刻～與女同事曖昧不清的親密關係～
source:
You play as an overworked IT staff member who's not only dealing with a recent heartbreak, but is suddenly assigned an urgent project. The company pairs you with two exceptional engineers—the top-tier veteran Gold and the talented newcomer Ruby—to complete the task.

As the final month unfolds, you gradually develop unexpected relationships with both of them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4219400/]Steam[/url]]
